maintainer_procedure: Hashes are always computed from the file (sha256sum); never copied from documentation.
A record whose file is absent keeps status 'missing' forever until the actual artifact reappears and re-hashes identically.
New entries must record step/epoch/metadata read via torch.load, not assumed from filenames.
The RL warm start must reference a record with status 'verified' and designated_warm_start=true.
scripts/validate_checkpoints.py re-verifies this file against disk and fails on any mismatch.
designation_procedure: A replacement supervised baseline is designated ONLY by (1) an equal-conditions head-to-head or Stockfish-ladder evaluation whose record (games, seeds, openings, model hashes) is stored in reports/ or docs/, and (2) setting designated_warm_start=true plus designation_evidence on exactly one 'verified' record here. Undesignated checkpoints must not be used to start an RL campaign.
